target.outcome: Cumulative confirmed COVID-19 infections on 17 March, 7 April, and 27 April 2020
target.effect_scale: Outcome ratio per doubling of annual PM10 exceedance days
target.exposure_assignment: Nearest EEA E1a validated daily PM10 monitor within 50 km of municipal-capital centroid
target.model: OLS log(infections) on log(PM10 exceedance days) and log(2019 municipal population density)
target.named_outcome_source: Italian Civil Protection Department provincial daily COVID-19 archive

coverage.rule: Nearest monitor within 50 km, at least 75% valid 2018 daily data, positive exposure and outcomes; retain 55 eligible capitals by SHA256 rank.
coverage.notes: All selected cities have 365 valid daily PM10 values (100% coverage); nearest-monitor distance 0.08-45.43 km.
